why: Found by I120 while writing its prereg, before any build commit or measured run (Q67: a test is never dropped from its CI job; amended to name the mode it was written for). P6 says that without the opt-ins every output is as before, so no protocol earlier than I117's names go.ops. It globbed every spec/*/lib/*.json except i117_run.json, so it also judged later keys: I120's protocol (spec/M6/lib/i120_run.json, I117's plus go.store_scope) carries I117's go.ops by construction and would fail it, although no earlier protocol changed. The amended check also skips the protocols of I117 and later keys (an iteration number of 117 or more, read from the protocol's own iteration field), as I115 and I112 amended their own P6 checks. Every earlier protocol is still checked, and the assertion is unchanged.
